question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Zany."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Sensible.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Zany" means amusingly unconventional, eccentric, or comically crazy in behavior. (सनकी या विचित्र-हास्यास्पद)

 

• "Sensible" means having or showing good judgment; practical and reasonable in behavior, and figuratively is the opposite of silly or eccentric conduct. It is therefore the correct antonym. (समझदार या व्यावहारिक)
◦ Example: She gave sensible advice that helped him make the right decision.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Wacky (विचित्र) — funny or amusing in a slightly odd way; a synonym of zany, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Eccentric (सनकी) — unconventional and slightly strange in behavior; a synonym of zany, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Comical (हास्यास्पद) — amusing in a slightly odd way; a synonym of zany, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of zany: sensible, serious, sober, conventional, rational.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Ominous (अशुभ): Auspicious (शुभ), Promising (आशाजनक)

2. Perfidious (विश्वासघाती): Loyal (वफादार), Faithful (निष्ठावान)

3. Recalcitrant (अवज्ञाकारी): Compliant (आज्ञाकारी), Obedient (आज्ञापालक)

4. Taciturn (मितभाषी): Talkative (बातूनी), Loquacious (वाचाल)

5. Unwavering (अटल): Fickle (चंचल), Hesitant (झिझकने वाला)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "oppugn".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Defend.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Oppugn" means to call into question or attack by argument; to oppose or dispute. (विरोध करना)
◦ Example: The lawyer moved to oppugn the validity of the confession obtained under duress.

 

• "Defend" means to protect from harm, criticism, or attack, and is therefore the correct antonym. (बचाव करना)
◦ Example: She stood up to defend her colleague against the unfair allegations.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Contest (विवाद करना): To dispute or challenge something — a synonym of oppugn, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Impugn (लांछन लगाना): To challenge the truth or integrity of something — a synonym of oppugn, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Dispute (विवाद करना): To argue against or question the validity of something — a synonym of oppugn, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of oppugn: contest, impugn, dispute, challenge, oppose, contradict.

 

• Synonyms of defend: protect, guard, shield, uphold, support.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Benevolent (दयालु): Malevolent (द्वेषपूर्ण), Cruel (क्रूर)

2. Candid (स्पष्टवादी): Reticent (अल्पभाषी), Evasive (टालमटोल करने वाला)

3. Diligent (मेहनती): Lazy (आलसी), Slothful (सुस्त)

4. Frugal (मितव्ययी): Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Wasteful (अपव्ययी)

5. Gregarious (मिलनसार): Solitary (एकांतप्रिय), Aloof (अलग-थलग रहने वाला)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Obsequious."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Assertive.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Obsequious" means excessively eager to please or obey; fawning and servile toward others, especially those in authority. (चाटुकार)

 

• "Assertive" means confidently stating one's opinions or needs without being aggressive, and figuratively/practically standing firm rather than servilely yielding to others. It is therefore the correct antonym. (दृढ़ता से अपनी बात रखने वाला)
◦ Example: A good manager must be assertive with the team while still respecting everyone's viewpoint.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Servile (दास के समान) — excessively submissive; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 2: Fawning (चापलूसी करने वाला) — displaying exaggerated flattery; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 3: Sycophantic (चापलूस) — behaving obsequiously to gain advantage; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Other antonyms of obsequious: proud, independent, domineering, haughty, defiant.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Humble (विनम्र): Arrogant (अभिमानी), Haughty (घमंडी)

2. Insipid (फीका): Flavorful (स्वादिष्ट), Zesty (चटपटा)

3. Jovial (प्रसन्नचित्त): Gloomy (उदास), Somber (गंभीर)

4. Lucid (स्पष्ट): Confusing (भ्रमित करने वाला), Obscure (अस्पष्ट)

5. Meticulous (सूक्ष्म/सतर्क): Careless (लापरवाह), Slapdash (जल्दबाजी में किया गया)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "soporific".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Stimulating.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Soporific" means tending to induce sleep or drowsiness; dull enough to make one sleepy. (नींद लाने वाला)
◦ Example: The professor's monotonous lecture had a soporific effect on the entire class.

 

• "Stimulating" means exciting interest, energy, or alertness, and is therefore the correct antonym. (उत्तेजक)
◦ Example: The debate competition was a stimulating experience for all the participants.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Sedative (शामक): Having a calming, sleep-inducing effect — a synonym of soporific, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Tedious (उबाऊ): So dull and monotonous as to cause drowsiness — a synonym of soporific, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Somnolent (तंद्रालु): Sleepy or drowsy, or causing drowsiness — a synonym of soporific, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of soporific: sedative, somnolent, tedious, hypnotic, sleep-inducing.

 

• Synonyms of stimulating: exciting, invigorating, energizing, exhilarating.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Naive (भोला): Sophisticated (परिष्कृत), Worldly (अनुभवी)

2. Obstinate (जिद्दी): Flexible (लचीला), Compliant (आज्ञाकारी)

3. Pensive (चिंतनशील): Carefree (निश्चिंत), Cheerful (प्रसन्न)

4. Quell (दबाना): Incite (उकसाना), Provoke (भड़काना)

5. Resilient (शीघ्र उबरने वाला): Fragile (नाजुक), Delicate (कोमल)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Quixotic."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Pragmatic.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Quixotic" means extremely idealistic and unrealistic, often pursuing impractical goals with romantic enthusiasm. (अव्यावहारिक रूप से आदर्शवादी)

 

• "Pragmatic" means dealing with things sensibly and realistically, based on practical considerations, and figuratively/practically grounded in what actually works rather than idealistic fancy. It is therefore the correct antonym. (व्यावहारिक)
◦ Example: Instead of chasing an idealistic scheme, the new manager took a pragmatic approach to cutting costs.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Idealistic (आदर्शवादी) — pursuing high, often unrealistic ideals; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 3: Impractical (अव्यावहारिक) — not sensible or workable in practice; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 4: Utopian (काल्पनिक) — based on an impossibly ideal vision; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Other antonyms of quixotic: realistic, practical, sensible, down-to-earth, rational.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Sagacious (बुद्धिमान): Foolish (मूर्ख), Unwise (नासमझ)

2. Taciturn (अल्पभाषी): Talkative (बातूनी), Loquacious (वाचाल)

3. Ubiquitous (सर्वव्यापी): Rare (दुर्लभ), Scarce (कम)

4. Volatile (अस्थिर): Stable (स्थिर), Steady (दृढ़)

5. Wary (सतर्क): Trusting (विश्वास करने वाला), Unsuspecting (बेखबर)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "vociferous".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Silent.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Vociferous" means expressing opinions or feelings in a loud and forceful way. (शोर मचाकर बोलने वाला)
◦ Example: The vociferous crowd outside the courtroom demanded justice for the victim.

 

• "Silent" means making or having no sound; not speaking, and is therefore the correct antonym. (मौन)
◦ Example: The students remained silent throughout the principal's stern warning.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Loud (तेज़ आवाज़ वाला): Producing a strong, noisy sound — a synonym of vociferous, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Clamorous (शोर मचाने वाला): Making a loud and confused noise, especially in protest — a synonym of vociferous, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Boisterous (उछल-कूद करने वाला): Noisy, energetic, and unrestrained — a synonym of vociferous, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of vociferous: loud, clamorous, boisterous, strident, noisy.

 

• Synonyms of silent: quiet, mute, hushed, noiseless.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Zealous (उत्साही): Apathetic (उदासीन), Indifferent (निरपेक्ष)

2. Amiable (मैत्रीपूर्ण): Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Unfriendly (अमित्रतापूर्ण)

3. Belligerent (आक्रामक): Peaceful (शांतिपूर्ण), Amicable (मैत्रीपूर्ण)

4. Coherent (सुसंगत): Incoherent (असंगत), Disjointed (बिखरा हुआ)

5. Docile (आज्ञाकारी): Unruly (उद्दंड), Rebellious (विद्रोही)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Furtive."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Open.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Furtive" means done secretly or stealthily to avoid being noticed, characterized by a sly or evasive manner. (चोरी-छिपे किया गया)

 

• "Open" means not hidden or secretive; frank and honest in manner, and figuratively/practically done in plain view rather than sneaked about. It is therefore the correct antonym. (खुला/स्पष्ट)
◦ Example: He was refreshingly open about the company's financial troubles at the meeting.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Secretive (गुप्त रखने वाला) — inclined to keep things hidden; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 2: Stealthy (चुपके से करने वाला) — cautious and quiet to avoid being detected; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 3: Clandestine (गुप्त) — kept secret, especially for an illicit purpose; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Other antonyms of furtive: candid, honest, forthright, straightforward, blatant.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Erudite (विद्वान): Ignorant (अज्ञानी), Uneducated (अशिक्षित)

2. Frivolous (तुच्छ): Serious (गंभीर), Sensible (समझदार)

3. Garrulous (बकवादी): Reticent (अल्पभाषी), Quiet (शांत)

4. Haphazard (अव्यवस्थित): Systematic (व्यवस्थित), Organized (संगठित)

5. Impetuous (उतावला): Cautious (सतर्क), Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "exiguous".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Plentiful.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Exiguous" means scanty or meagre; barely sufficient in amount. (अल्प)
◦ Example: The refugees survived for weeks on an exiguous supply of food and water.

 

• "Plentiful" means existing in large quantities; abundant, and is therefore the correct antonym. (प्रचुर)
◦ Example: This year's monsoon brought a plentiful harvest to the farmers of the region.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Scanty (अपर्याप्त): Insufficient or barely enough in amount — a synonym of exiguous, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Meagre (तुच्छ): Lacking in quantity or richness — a synonym of exiguous, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Sparse (विरल): Thinly dispersed or scanty — a synonym of exiguous, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of exiguous: scanty, meagre, sparse, insufficient, paltry.

 

• Synonyms of plentiful: abundant, ample, copious, bountiful.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Judicious (विवेकपूर्ण): Reckless (लापरवाह), Imprudent (अविवेकी)

2. Languid (सुस्त): Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Vigorous (जोशीला)

3. Malign (निंदा करना): Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Compliment (तारीफ करना)

4. Nefarious (दुष्ट): Virtuous (सद्गुणी), Honorable (सम्मानजनक)

5. Opulent (ऐश्वर्यशाली): Poor (गरीब), Impoverished (निर्धन)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Vindicate."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Accuse.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Vindicate" means to clear someone of blame or suspicion by providing proof, or to justify a claim that was previously doubted. (निर्दोष सिद्ध करना)

 

• "Accuse" means to charge someone with wrongdoing or a fault, and figuratively/practically to place blame on someone rather than clear them of it. It is therefore the correct antonym. (आरोप लगाना)
◦ Example: The prosecution rose to accuse the defendant of deliberately falsifying the records.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Justify (उचित ठहराना) — to show something to be right or reasonable; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 3: Absolve (दोषमुक्त करना) — to free someone from blame or guilt; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 4: Exonerate (निर्दोष सिद्ध करना) — to officially clear someone of a charge; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Other antonyms of vindicate: blame, condemn, incriminate, implicate, denounce.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Placid (शांत): Turbulent (अशांत), Agitated (व्याकुल)

2. Querulous (शिकायती): Content (संतुष्ट), Uncomplaining (बिना शिकायत के)

3. Recalcitrant (अवज्ञाकारी): Compliant (अनुपालनशील), Obedient (आज्ञाकारी)

4. Sanguine (आशावादी): Pessimistic (निराशावादी), Despondent (निराश)

5. Torpid (निष्क्रिय): Active (सक्रिय), Lively (जीवंत)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "nugatory".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Significant.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Nugatory" means of no real value or importance; trifling or futile. (तुच्छ)
◦ Example: Without proper implementation, the new policy remains nugatory in practice.

 

• "Significant" means having importance or notable meaning, and is therefore the correct antonym. (महत्वपूर्ण)
◦ Example: The scientists made a significant breakthrough in cancer research this year.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Trivial (तुच्छ): Of little value or importance — a synonym of nugatory, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Worthless (बेकार): Having no real worth or usefulness — a synonym of nugatory, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Futile (व्यर्थ): Producing no useful result; pointless — a synonym of nugatory, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of nugatory: trivial, worthless, futile, trifling, inconsequential.

 

• Synonyms of significant: important, notable, considerable, momentous.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Unassuming (निरभिमानी): Pretentious (दिखावटी), Boastful (डींग मारने वाला)

2. Vapid (नीरस): Interesting (रोचक), Engaging (आकर्षक)

3. Wistful (लालसापूर्ण): Content (संतुष्ट), Satisfied (तृप्त)

4. Abstemious (संयमी): Gluttonous (पेटू), Indulgent (भोगविलासी)

5. Brazen (निर्लज्ज): Timid (डरपोक), Shy (संकोची)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Transitory."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Eternal.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Transitory" means lasting only for a short time; not permanent or enduring. (अस्थायी)

 

• "Eternal" means lasting or existing forever, without beginning or end, and figuratively/practically enduring endlessly rather than passing quickly. It is therefore the correct antonym. (शाश्वत)
◦ Example: The poet spoke of an eternal love that would outlast the stars themselves.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Temporary (अस्थायी) — lasting for only a limited time; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 2: Fleeting (क्षणभंगुर) — passing swiftly, not lasting; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 3: Ephemeral (अल्पकालिक) — lasting for a very short time; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Other antonyms of transitory: permanent, everlasting, enduring, perpetual, lasting.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Convivial (मिलनसार): Reserved (संकोची), Unsociable (असामाजिक)

2. Deleterious (हानिकारक): Beneficial (लाभदायक), Wholesome (स्वास्थ्यकर)

3. Ebullient (उत्साह से भरपूर): Depressed (उदास), Listless (निरुत्साह)

4. Fastidious (चूज़ी): Careless (लापरवाह), Undemanding (कम मांग वाला)

5. Gullible (भोला): Skeptical (संशयवादी), Suspicious (संदेहपूर्ण)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "impecunious".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Wealthy.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Impecunious" means having little or no money; habitually poor. (निर्धन)
◦ Example: The impecunious scholar could barely afford books, yet he never stopped studying.

 

• "Wealthy" means having a great deal of money or valuable possessions, and is therefore the correct antonym. (धनी)
◦ Example: The wealthy industrialist donated a large sum to the flood relief fund.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Penniless (कंगाल): Having no money at all — a synonym of impecunious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Destitute (निराश्रित): Without the basic necessities of life due to extreme poverty — a synonym of impecunious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Indigent (निर्धन): Poor; needy — a synonym of impecunious, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of impecunious: penniless, destitute, indigent, poor, needy.

 

• Synonyms of wealthy: rich, affluent, prosperous, well-off.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Hapless (अभागा): Fortunate (भाग्यशाली), Lucky (सौभाग्यशाली)

2. Inept (अयोग्य): Skilled (कुशल), Competent (सक्षम)

3. Jaded (उकताया हुआ): Enthusiastic (उत्साही), Fresh (ताज़ा)

4. Keen (उत्सुक): Reluctant (अनिच्छुक), Indifferent (उदासीन)

5. Lethargic (सुस्त): Vigorous (जोशीला), Spirited (उत्साही)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Ostentatious."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Modest.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Ostentatious" means characterized by vulgar or pretentious display, meant to impress others or attract attention. (दिखावटी)

 

• "Modest" means unassuming in the estimation of one's abilities or achievements, simple and not showy, and figuratively/practically restrained rather than flaunted for attention. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सादा/विनम्र)
◦ Example: Despite her enormous success, she led a modest life away from the media glare.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Showy (दिखावटी) — attracting attention through a striking display; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 3: Flamboyant (भड़कीला) — tending to attract attention because of confidence and stylishness; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 4: Flashy (चमकदार) — attractive in a vulgar, showy way; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Other antonyms of ostentatious: unassuming, simple, understated, plain, unpretentious.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Munificent (अति उदार): Stingy (कंजूस), Miserly (कंजूस)

2. Nonchalant (उदासीन): Anxious (चिंतित), Concerned (चिंतित)

3. Officious (दखल देने वाला): Reserved (संकोची), Retiring (अंतर्मुखी)

4. Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण): Reckless (लापरवाह), Rash (उतावला)

5. Ravenous (अत्यंत भूखा): Satiated (तृप्त), Full (भरपेट)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "dissemble".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Reveal.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Dissemble" means to conceal one's true feelings, motives, or beliefs behind a false appearance. (छिपाना)
◦ Example: He tried to dissemble his nervousness by smiling calmly during the interview.

 

• "Reveal" means to make known or show something previously hidden, and is therefore the correct antonym. (प्रकट करना)
◦ Example: The journalist decided to reveal her source only after the trial had ended.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Disguise (छिपाना): To conceal the true nature of something — a synonym of dissemble, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Feign (बहाना करना): To pretend to feel or be affected by something — a synonym of dissemble, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Pretend (दिखावा करना): To put on a false show; to feign — a synonym of dissemble, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of dissemble: disguise, feign, pretend, camouflage, mask.

 

• Synonyms of reveal: disclose, expose, divulge, unveil.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Staid (गंभीर स्वभाव वाला): Wild (उच्छृंखल), Adventurous (साहसिक)

2. Tenacious (दृढ़): Yielding (झुकने वाला), Irresolute (अनिश्चयी)

3. Uncouth (अशिष्ट): Refined (परिष्कृत), Polished (सुसंस्कृत)

4. Vindictive (प्रतिशोधी): Forgiving (क्षमाशील), Merciful (दयालु)

5. Wanton (उच्छृंखल): Chaste (सदाचारी), Restrained (संयमित)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Redolent."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Unscented.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Redolent" means having or exuding a strong, pleasant smell; also, evocative or reminiscent of something. (सुगंधित, स्मरण कराने वाला)

 

• "Unscented" means having no smell or fragrance at all, and figuratively/practically lacking any evocative quality associated with a strong scent. It is therefore the correct antonym. (गंधरहित)
◦ Example: The unscented soap was preferred by people with sensitive skin.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Fragrant (सुगंधित) — having a pleasant smell; a synonym of redolent, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Aromatic (सुगंधयुक्त) — having a distinctive, pleasant smell; a synonym of redolent, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Evocative (स्मृति जगाने वाला) — bringing strong images or memories to mind, matching redolent's figurative sense; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of redolent: odourless, insipid, bland, nondescript.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Meticulous (सूक्ष्म/सतर्क): Careless (लापरवाह), Sloppy (अस्तव्यस्त)

2. Candid (स्पष्टवादी): Evasive (टालमटोल करने वाला), Deceptive (धोखेबाज़)

3. Frugal (मितव्ययी): Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Wasteful (अपव्ययी)

4. Ephemeral (क्षणभंगुर): Permanent (स्थायी), Enduring (चिरस्थायी)

5. Belligerent (आक्रामक): Peaceful (शांतिपूर्ण), Amicable (मैत्रीपूर्ण)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "lugubrious".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Joyous.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Lugubrious" means mournful, dismal, or exaggeratedly sorrowful. (शोकपूर्ण, उदास)
◦ Example: The lugubrious tone of the funeral speech brought tears to everyone's eyes.

 

• "Joyous" means full of happiness and joy, and is therefore the correct antonym. (आनंदित, हर्षित)
◦ Example: The wedding was a joyous occasion filled with laughter and music.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Mournful (शोकाकुल): Expressing or feeling deep sorrow — a synonym of lugubrious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Doleful (उदास, खिन्न): Sad and mournful in expression — a synonym of lugubrious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Dismal (निराशाजनक, उदास): Depressing or dreary — a synonym of lugubrious, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of lugubrious: mournful, doleful, dismal, gloomy, sorrowful, dreary.

 

• Synonyms of joyous: happy, joyful, elated, cheerful, delighted.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Austere (कठोर व सादा): Luxurious (विलासितापूर्ण), Ornate (अलंकृत)

2. Obdurate (हठी): Flexible (लचीला), Compliant (आज्ञाकारी)

3. Frivolous (तुच्छ): Serious (गंभीर), Sensible (समझदार)

4. Diligent (परिश्रमी): Lazy (आलसी), Indolent (सुस्त)

5. Amiable (मिलनसार): Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Unfriendly (अमित्र)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Pernicious."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Innocuous.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Pernicious" means having a harmful effect, especially in a gradual or subtle way. (हानिकारक, घातक)

 

• "Innocuous" means not harmful or offensive; harmless, and figuratively/practically safe to be around or exposed to. It is therefore the correct antonym. (हानिरहित, निरापद)
◦ Example: The prank turned out to be innocuous and no one was hurt.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Deleterious (हानिकारक) — causing harm or damage, often gradually; a synonym of pernicious.

 

• Option 3: Injurious (नुकसानदेह) — causing injury or harm; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Noxious (विषैला) — harmful or poisonous in effect; a synonym of pernicious.

 

• Other antonyms of pernicious: harmless, benign, beneficial, wholesome.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Verbose (शब्दाडंबरपूर्ण): Concise (संक्षिप्त), Terse (संक्षिप्त एवं रूखा)

2. Timid (डरपोक): Bold (साहसी), Audacious (दुस्साहसी)

3. Malevolent (द्वेषपूर्ण): Benevolent (परोपकारी), Kind (दयालु)

4. Opaque (अपारदर्शी): Transparent (पारदर्शी), Clear (स्पष्ट)

5. Ambiguous (अस्पष्ट): Clear (स्पष्ट), Unequivocal (असंदिग्ध)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "incipient".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Advanced.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Incipient" means beginning to exist or develop; in an early or initial stage. (आरंभिक, प्रारंभिक)
◦ Example: Doctors detected an incipient infection before it could spread.

 

• "Advanced" means far on in development or progress, and is therefore the correct antonym. (उन्नत, विकसित)
◦ Example: The disease had reached an advanced stage by the time it was diagnosed.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Nascent (उदीयमान, प्रारंभिक): Just coming into existence and beginning to develop — a synonym of incipient, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Emerging (उभरता हुआ): Coming into being or prominence — a synonym of incipient, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Embryonic (भ्रूणीय, अल्पविकसित): In a very early, undeveloped stage — a synonym of incipient, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of incipient: nascent, emerging, embryonic, beginning, developing.

 

• Synonyms of advanced: developed, progressive, sophisticated, forward, mature.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Obsolete (अप्रचलित): Modern (आधुनिक), Current (प्रचलित)

2. Docile (आज्ञाकारी): Rebellious (विद्रोही), Unruly (उद्दंड)

3. Genuine (वास्तविक): Fake (नकली), Fraudulent (कपटपूर्ण)

4. Cordial (सौहार्दपूर्ण): Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Icy (रूखा)

5. Zealous (उत्साही): Apathetic (निरुत्साही), Indifferent (उदासीन)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Pulverize."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Restore.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Pulverize" means to crush or grind something into fine powder or dust, and figuratively to defeat or destroy something completely. (चूर्ण करना, कुचल देना)

 

• "Restore" means to bring something back to its original or good condition, and figuratively/practically to repair or rebuild rather than destroy. It is therefore the correct antonym. (पुनर्स्थापित करना, मरम्मत करना)
◦ Example: The team worked for months to restore the ancient monument.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Crush (कुचलना) — to press with force so as to break or destroy; a synonym of pulverize.

 

• Option 2: Demolish (ध्वस्त करना) — to completely destroy a structure; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Shatter (चकनाचूर करना) — to break suddenly and violently into pieces; a synonym of pulverize.

 

• Other antonyms of pulverize: rebuild, repair, mend, reconstruct.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Vindictive (प्रतिशोधी): Forgiving (क्षमाशील), Merciful (दयालु)

2. Turbulent (अशांत): Calm (शांत), Peaceful (शांतिपूर्ण)

3. Naive (भोला): Sophisticated (परिष्कृत), Worldly-wise (व्यवहार-कुशल)

4. Placid (शांत): Agitated (उत्तेजित), Volatile (अस्थिर)

5. Skeptical (संशयवादी): Credulous (जल्दी विश्वास करने वाला), Trusting (भरोसा करने वाला)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "recalcitrance".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Compliance.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Recalcitrance" means stubborn, obstinate resistance to authority or control. (हठधर्मिता, अवज्ञा)
◦ Example: The teacher grew frustrated with the student's recalcitrance towards classroom rules.

 

• "Compliance" means the act of obeying or conforming to a rule, request, or authority, and is therefore the correct antonym. (अनुपालन, आज्ञापालन)
◦ Example: The company ensured full compliance with the new safety regulations.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Defiance (अवज्ञा, चुनौती): Open resistance or bold disobedience to authority — a synonym of recalcitrance, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Obstinacy (हठ, जिद): Stubborn refusal to change one's attitude — a synonym of recalcitrance, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Disobedience (अवज्ञा, आज्ञा उल्लंघन): Failure or refusal to obey rules — a synonym of recalcitrance, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of recalcitrance: defiance, obstinacy, disobedience, intransigence, stubbornness.

 

• Synonyms of compliance: obedience, submission, conformity, acquiescence.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण): Reckless (लापरवाह), Imprudent (अविवेकी)

2. Tenacious (दृढ़): Irresolute (अनिश्चित), Yielding (नमनीय)

3. Servile (दास-भाव वाला): Domineering (प्रभुत्वशाली), Imperious (तानाशाही)

4. Ostentatious (दिखावटी): Modest (विनम्र), Understated (संयत)

5. Callous (निष्ठुर): Compassionate (दयालु), Sympathetic (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Torpor."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Liveliness.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Torpor" means a state of physical and mental inactivity, sluggishness, or lethargy. (सुस्ती, निष्क्रियता)

 

• "Liveliness" means the quality of being full of energy and life, and figuratively/practically an active, alert state opposite to sluggishness. It is therefore the correct antonym. (स्फूर्ति, जीवंतता)
◦ Example: The children's liveliness filled the house with laughter and energy.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Lethargy (सुस्ती) — a lack of energy and enthusiasm; a synonym of torpor.

 

• Option 3: Sluggishness (मंदता) — the state of being slow-moving or lacking energy; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Stupor (मूर्च्छा, जड़ता) — a state of near-unconsciousness or dazed inactivity; a synonym of torpor.

 

• Other antonyms of torpor: vigour, vitality, energy, alertness.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Erudite (विद्वान): Ignorant (अज्ञानी), Illiterate (अनपढ़)

2. Gregarious (मिलनसार): Solitary (एकांतप्रिय), Reserved (संकोची)

3. Impetuous (उतावला): Cautious (सतर्क), Deliberate (सोच-समझकर)

4. Lucid (स्पष्ट): Confusing (भ्रामक), Muddled (उलझा हुआ)

5. Parsimonious (कंजूस): Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Liberal (उदार)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "prosaic".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Imaginative.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Prosaic" means dull, ordinary, and lacking in imagination or excitement. (नीरस, सामान्य)
◦ Example: His prosaic account of the trip failed to capture its true excitement.

 

• "Imaginative" means having or showing creativity, inventiveness, or resourcefulness, and is therefore the correct antonym. (कल्पनाशील, रचनात्मक)
◦ Example: The imaginative design of the building won several architecture awards.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Mundane (सांसारिक, साधारण): Lacking interest or excitement; commonplace — a synonym of prosaic, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Dull (नीरस, उबाऊ): Not interesting or exciting; tedious — a synonym of prosaic, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Humdrum (नीरस, एकरस): Lacking excitement or variety; monotonous — a synonym of prosaic, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of prosaic: mundane, dull, humdrum, ordinary, unimaginative, tedious.

 

• Synonyms of imaginative: creative, inventive, resourceful, visionary, original.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Ostracize (बहिष्कृत करना): Welcome (स्वागत करना), Embrace (अपनाना)

2. Vivacious (जीवंत): Lethargic (सुस्त), Listless (उदासीन)

3. Insipid (फीका): Flavourful (स्वादिष्ट), Exciting (रोचक)

4. Nefarious (दुष्ट): Virtuous (सदाचारी), Honourable (सम्माननीय)

5. Clandestine (गुप्त): Open (खुला), Public (सार्वजनिक)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Voluble."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Reticent.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Voluble" means talking fluently, readily, and incessantly; markedly talkative. (वाचाल, बातूनी)

 

• "Reticent" means not revealing one's thoughts or feelings readily; reserved in speech, and figuratively/practically reluctant to talk much. It is therefore the correct antonym. (मितभाषी, अल्पभाषी)
◦ Example: He remained reticent about his personal life even with close friends.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Garrulous (बकवादी) — excessively talkative, especially about trivial matters; a synonym of voluble.

 

• Option 2: Talkative (बातूनी) — fond of or given to talking a great deal; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Loquacious (वाचाल) — tending to talk a great deal; a synonym of voluble.

 

• Other antonyms of voluble: taciturn, quiet, silent, uncommunicative.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Congenial (अनुकूल): Unpleasant (अप्रिय), Disagreeable (अरुचिकर)

2. Fastidious (नकचढ़ा): Undemanding (कम मांग वाला), Easygoing (सहज)

3. Garish (भड़कीला): Tasteful (सुरुचिपूर्ण), Subtle (सूक्ष्म)

4. Haughty (घमंडी): Humble (नम्र), Modest (विनम्र)

5. Indolent (आलसी): Diligent (परिश्रमी), Active (सक्रिय)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "esoteric".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Straightforward.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Esoteric" means intended for or understood by only a small, specialized group; obscure and abstruse. (गूढ़, दुर्बोध)
◦ Example: The professor's esoteric research is understood by only a handful of specialists worldwide.

 

• "Straightforward" means easy to understand or do; simple and uncomplicated, and is therefore the correct antonym. (सरल, स्पष्ट)
◦ Example: The instructions were straightforward enough for a beginner to follow.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Abstruse (दुर्बोध, जटिल): Difficult to understand; obscure — a synonym of esoteric, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Arcane (गुप्त, रहस्यमय): Known or understood by very few; mysterious — a synonym of esoteric, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Obscure (अस्पष्ट, अल्पज्ञात): Not clearly expressed or easily understood — a synonym of esoteric, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of esoteric: abstruse, arcane, obscure, cryptic, recondite.

 

• Synonyms of straightforward: simple, clear, uncomplicated, plain, direct.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Jubilant (हर्षित): Sorrowful (दुखी), Gloomy (उदास)

2. Languid (शिथिल): Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Vigorous (जोशीला)

3. Meagre (अपर्याप्त): Abundant (प्रचुर), Plentiful (भरपूर)

4. Obstinate (हठी): Amenable (सहमत होने वाला), Yielding (नमनीय)

5. Pensive (विचारमग्न): Carefree (निश्चिंत), Cheerful (प्रसन्न)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Quell."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Provoke.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Quell" means to put an end to something, especially unrest or rebellion, typically by force; to suppress. (दबाना, शांत करना)

 

• "Provoke" means to stimulate or give rise to a strong reaction, especially anger or unrest, and figuratively/practically to incite rather than suppress. It is therefore the correct antonym. (उकसाना, भड़काना)
◦ Example: His careless remark was enough to provoke a heated argument.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Suppress (दबाना) — to forcibly put an end to or prevent; a synonym of quell.

 

• Option 3: Subdue (वश में करना) — to bring under control by force; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Quash (कुचल देना) — to reject or suppress forcefully; a synonym of quell.

 

• Other antonyms of quell: incite, instigate, foment, encourage.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Quaint (विचित्र): Modern (आधुनिक), Ordinary (साधारण)

2. Rancorous (द्वेषपूर्ण): Amicable (मैत्रीपूर्ण), Friendly (मित्रवत)

3. Sagacious (बुद्धिमान): Foolish (मूर्ख), Unwise (नासमझ)

4. Trepidation (घबराहट): Confidence (आत्मविश्वास), Composure (संयम)

5. Uncouth (असभ्य): Refined (परिष्कृत), Polished (सुसंस्कृत)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "palliate".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Worsen.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Palliate" means to make a disease or its symptoms less severe without curing it; to alleviate or ease. (कम करना, शमन करना)
◦ Example: The medicine helped palliate her chronic pain even though it could not cure the underlying condition.

 

• "Worsen" means to make or become worse, and is therefore the correct antonym. (बिगाड़ना, बदतर होना)
◦ Example: Ignoring the infection only worsened his condition.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Alleviate (कम करना, हल्का करना): To make suffering or a problem less severe — a synonym of palliate, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Mitigate (कम करना, नरम करना): To make less severe, serious, or painful — a synonym of palliate, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Assuage (शांत करना, सांत्वना देना): To make an unpleasant feeling less intense — a synonym of palliate, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of palliate: alleviate, mitigate, assuage, ease, soothe.

 

• Synonyms of worsen: aggravate, deteriorate, exacerbate, intensify.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Venerate (सम्मान करना): Despise (तिरस्कार करना), Disdain (तुच्छ समझना)

2. Wary (सतर्क): Careless (लापरवाह), Trusting (भरोसा करने वाला)

3. Xenophobic (विदेशी-द्वेषी): Welcoming (स्वागत करने वाला), Tolerant (सहिष्णु)

4. Yielding (नमनीय): Stubborn (हठी), Unyielding (अटल)

5. Zestful (उत्साही): Weary (थका हुआ), Listless (उदासीन)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Munificent."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Stingy.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Munificent" means very generous, especially in giving money or gifts. (अत्यंत उदार, दानशील)

 

• "Stingy" means unwilling to give or spend money or resources; not generous, and figuratively/practically the opposite of open-handed giving. It is therefore the correct antonym. (कंजूस, कृपण)
◦ Example: Despite his wealth, he was too stingy to donate even a small amount.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Generous (उदार) — showing a readiness to give more than is necessary; a synonym of munificent.

 

• Option 2: Bountiful (प्रचुर) — given or giving generously; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Lavish (अत्यधिक उदार) — sumptuously rich or generous in giving; a synonym of munificent.

 

• Other antonyms of munificent: miserly, parsimonious, tightfisted, ungenerous.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Abhor (घृणा करना): Adore (प्रेम करना), Cherish (संजोना)

2. Bombastic (शब्दाडंबरपूर्ण): Plain (सादा), Simple (सरल)

3. Circumspect (सावधान): Rash (उतावला), Reckless (लापरवाह)

4. Debilitate (कमजोर करना): Strengthen (मजबूत करना), Invigorate (स्फूर्ति देना)

5. Effervescent (उत्साही व जीवंत): Lethargic (सुस्त), Dull (नीरस)
